description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016102953 PLATE,MOUNTING: Line 0001 Qty 152 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0078 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
